metric.production_adoption_deployment_ev.limitations: No new provider call was made for this recertification row. Historical normalized scores are retained only for audit comparison and are not used by the v2 runner arithmetic.

metric.third_party_tool_availability.limitations: Star/fork counts and search-result absence are weak proxies (a tool could exist without being indexed yet); however, the consistent first-party-only pattern across every discovered artifact (compiler, LSP mentioned only in official docs, playground, formatter, first-party packages) plus zero independent hits after multiple targeted queries is convergent evidence of essentially no third-party tool ecosystem.
metric.third_party_tool_availability.selection_rule: Inspect the same fixed tool categories for every language and require independently maintained current tools; official first-party tools may be cited only as context, not as third-party availability.
